Commentary.Commentary: That's it from the series opener! A game getting over inside three days should tell you how superbly Australia have prepared for the tour. One would argue that the Indians will bounce back hard but to be honest, the momentum lies firmly with the visitors. Let's see what happens in the second Test when these two meet in Bengaluru on 4th March, 2017, at 0930 local time (0400 GMT). Until then, goodbye and take care. Cheers!

Man of the Match, Steve O'Keefe admits that it's a good feeling. Says that the Indian spinners also bowled well. Mentions that it is because of hard work that they won. Informs that he will forever remember the Hill's end (the end from where he got his wickets) and credits Steven Smith for supporting him and the fielders who took the catches. Adds that even Jadeja bowled beautifully, but was unfortunate to not get enough wickets. Mentions that the Australians have been working hard to not get beaten on the inside edge. Says that he's enjoying in India and calls Pune 'Sundar' (Beautiful). Ends by saying that he's looking forward to Bengaluru.

Australian skipper, Steven Smith says they knew it was going to be really difficult to play here but is really proud of his boys for the way they performed here. Mentions that everybody had plans and executed them very well. Gives special credit to Steve O'Keefe for his outstanding performance in the match and doesn't forget to mention Nathan Lyon for doing well too. Mentions that his team has some excellent players of spin and is happy that the squad is well-rounded. When asked about key moments in the game, points out Mitchell Starc's knock in the first innings and just the way his bowlers bowled overall. On Steve O'Keefe, says that he was disappointed with how he himself did on the first day, but then slowly came back as he got his length right. Stresses that he will be crucial for the series. On his ton, states that it took a lot of grit and determination and hopes that he can do it more frequently for his side.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli says the run (19-match unbeaten streak) was really good and the support they are getting is incredible. Admits that Australia outplayed India and says that his team wasn't good enough. Calls it their worst batting performance in the last two years. Mentions that they didn't apply themselves very well. Doesn't blame the pitch and praises the visitors' bowlers. States that they expected this kind of dry deck in Pune. Credits the Australian bowlers for their amazing bowling performance. Rues the catches dropped and informs that to pull themselves back after a couple of poor sessions was very hard. Says it is a big learning curve and it's necessary to accept that they played poorly. Praises Umesh Yadav for his performance in the first innings, especially in the heat and hopes for more such performances from him in Bengaluru.

It required a miracle of an effort from the home side on such a dodgy wicket to save this Test and nothing as such happened. Their batsmen failed to apply themselves and were caught off guard as the Aussie spinners got the better of them yet again, making full use of the pitch. India's 19-match unbeaten streak at home ends which means Kohli and co will have a lot to ponder about going into the next match but first let's wait and see what the two captains have got to say. Stay tuned for the presentation...

Smith won a good toss on day 1 but then had his side in trouble towards the end of the day. However, Mitchell Starc stepped up and unleashed a quickfire fifty to provide a much-needed impetus to his side. Then they came out all guns blazing with the ball on day 2 and not only steamrolled the hosts for a scanty 105, but also gained a handsome lead of 155. They swelled it to a mammoth 440 runs on the back of a superb ton from their skipper. Agreed he got reprieves but take nothing away from him. The middle and lower middle order also provided a handful support to Smith to put the hosts further under the pump.

A sensational performance from Australia! They go 1-0 up in the series and boy, they have done that by beating the hosts by a huge, huge margin. Though it was an all-round effort from them, the two Steves - Steve Smith and Steve O'Keefe - have got the job done. The former applied himself on a track that had dreadful turn and bounce and went on to score a Test ton while the latter coped really well with the conditions and spun the web beautifully around the Indian batsmen as he picked up 12 wickets in the match. This performance was his best, better than even any of his First Class matches.

OUT! That's it. Australia win by 333 runs! Slower delivery through the air, Jayant goes forward to defend but it hits his front pad and the ball lobs in the air behind as Wade moves to his left and takes it. The visitors appeal and the umpire obliges. Unfortunate decision that because it wasn't out as the replays failed to show any inside edge. But the Australians don't mind and they are delighted!
Flatter and outside off, Jayant rocks back and pushes it towards covers.
Jayant charges down the track and eases this floated delivery to long on. He has refused a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Jayant Yadav blocks it.
FOUR! Tosses this one around off, Jayant Yadav dances down the ground and whacks it over mid on for a boundary to make sure that India score more than they did in the first innings.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

NOT OUT! Tosses this on middle and leg, Jayant charges down the track and flicks it through fine leg. And this time around he wants a single. The fine leg fielder throws it at the striker's end and Wade clips the bails off. Australia go up and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays suggest that Umesh has made his ground.
A run out decision against Umesh Yadav is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Tossed up outside off, Jayant plays an elegant drive towards covers. No run taken.
Looped up delivery, Jayant looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and goes towards square leg.
Tosses this one around off, Jayant lofts it over mid on. The fielder chases it and surprisingly Jayant doesn't take a single.
Bowls this very full on middle, Jayant defends it back to the bowler.
Umesh Yadav is the last man in for India.

OUT! Lyon dismisses Ishant and SOK will not be able to dismiss all the Indian batsmen in one match. Bowls it slower through the air, on middle, Ishant comes forward to defend but it hits his gloves onto his thigh pad and lobs in the air towards Warner at leg slip who cups it easily. Australia need just 1 wicket to take the lead in this 4-match series.
Bowls this one around off, Ishant defends it towards mid-wicket.
Ishant Sharma is the next batsman in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Bowls it slightly quicker, Jadeja goes back wanting to cut but it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the stumps and off comes the bail. The ball stayed slightly slow and the batsman misread it. The southpaw has to depart and the end is near for India.
Bowls this on middle and leg, Jadeja blocks it.
Tosses this one outside off, Jadeja cuts it towards point.
Turn and bounce! Pitches this on middle and it spins away from Jadeja as Wade collects it with one hand.
Floats this one outside off, Jayant looks to drive but it goes off his pads towards covers.
Tossed up delivery, around off, Jayant dead-bats it.
Loops this up around off, Jayant prods forward to defend but the ball whizzes past his willow.
Bowls this slower through the air on the stumps, Jayant knocks it back to the bowler.
Shortish delivery, Jayant is cramped for room so he backs out and cuts it towards point.
Tossed up delivery, around off, Jayant is rock solid in defense.
Flatter and quicker, on the sticks, Jadeja gets forward and blocks it towards the leg side.
Jadeja gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it.
Tosses this one around off, Jadeja goes forward to defend and gets beaten by the turn. Australians appeal for a caught behind which is turned down.
Bowls a similar length, outside off, Jadeja lets it through.
Shortish delivery, outside off, Jadeja cuts it through point for a couple.
Slower delivery and on off, Jadeja buries it onto the pitch.
Nathan Lyon will bowl from the other end.
Jayant prods forward to defend this floated delivery.
Jayant Yadav is the new man in.

OUT! All the Indian batsmen are playing for the turn and falling prey to Steve O'Keefe. Bowls this slightly flatter on middle, Pujara leans forward to defend but plays down the wrong line and the ball raps his pads. Australia go up in a jiffy and the umpire obliges. The away side has struck straightaway.
Tosses this on middle and leg, Jadeja tucks it away through fine leg for a single.
The players are out on the middle for the session. Ravindra Jadeja will join Cheteshwar Pujara at the crease. Steve O'Keefe to continue his pending over...
... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

Needless to say whom the session belonged to! Australia are up and running away with the game here. After setting a mammoth target, they have ran riot once again through the hosts' batting line-up. Once again the man of the hour was Steve O'Keefe who has registered back-to-back 5-fers and mind you, he looks hungry for more. Lyon has given him good support again and the spinning duo has spun the web viciously around the batsmen. So, the writing seems to be on the wall for the home side and with a minimum 20 overs still to go in the day, it seems like this game could be well over before stumps. Join us in a bit for what could be the final session of the Test.

OUT! O'Keefe with another one. He has another 5-fer to his name, I'm running out of words to describe this man's performance. He bowls a slider which comes in with the arm, catches Saha on the pads and the appeal goes up almost immediately. The umpire takes a second and raises his finger in response. Australia inch closer to victory as India have lost more than half their side now.
Stays right behind the line and blocks it rather carefully.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy ball on the stumps, Saha sweeps it to backward square leg. One run taken.
Floats this up there, Cheteshwar gets to the pitch and wrists it down to long on for one.

Huge, huge lbw appeal but it's denied. Tossed up around off, Saha prods forward to defend but is rapped on the front pad. The umpire denies it as it was spinning too much and would have eventually gone down the leg side.
Tossed up on the stumps, Che drives it to long on for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Dropped! And from the unlikeliest of fielders. David Warner the culprit here. Short and turning in, Pujara goes back and tucks it straight to Warner at leg slip. He gets low to catch it with his right hand but cannot hold on to it.
On a shorter length, around off, blocked.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller around off, gets an inside edge onto his pads on his forward defense.
Full and darted on middle, a bit too straight as Wriddhiman Saha defends it.
Venomous! Bowls this on a driving length, around off, rises on Saha out of nowhere and goes past the edge. Saha did well to drops his arms and evade it.
FOUR! Looped up around off, Saha leans into it and with some superb timing, drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Turn and bounce once more for Nathan Lyon, Pujara goes deep inside his crease and works it down towards fine leg for a couple.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
A lot of fizz on that one. Rips and zips inside as it catches Pujara on the thigh pad.
Cheteshwar Pujara has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length, around off, kept out off the back foot rather solidly.
Flat, short and on the stumps, Pujara mistimes the pull to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Fuller outside off, driven to mid off for nothing.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wriddhiman Saha is the next man in to bat.

OUT! The decision is overturned and Steve O'Keefe has got his maiden 10-fer in Tests. What an outstanding feat from the spinner. Was brilliant in the first innings and has now continued that excellence in this one. He bowls it full on the stumps, Ashwin looks to play at it with bat and pad close together. It hits him but not sure what got hit first. The umpire doesn't respond to the lbw appeal and so Australia review it. Replays show it is pad first and Ashwin is caught dead plumb in front of the stumps.
Australia have taken a review for an lbw decision against Ravichandran Ashwin.

Beaten! Lovely stuff from Steve O'Keefe. He uses the angle well, tosses it up around off, gets it to rip away heavily and beat the outside edge of the bat. Ashwin had no chance of doing anything about that.
Full and in the off stump channel, it's kept out with the full face of the bat.
From around the wicket, it's floated outside off, turns away as Ashwin leaves it alone.
Tossed up outside off, Ashwin uppishly drives it through the line. Hits it wide of mid off and just about manages to beat a diving Josh Hazlewood. Three runs are taken.
FOUR! Wonderful execution from Ravi Ashwin. He kneels down to this flighted delivery and reverse sweeps it through point for a boundary.
Loopy off spinner just outside off, Ashwin presses forward keeping bat and pad close together, the ball goes off the pad and falls short of the short mid-wicket fielder.
Bit fullish in length, on the stumps, comfortably kept out down on the track.
Darts it on middle and leg, raps Ashwin on the pads as he looks to play this across the line.
Off break on middle and off, turning in sharply as Pujara nudges it past leg gully for one.
Great use of the wrists. Pujara leans ahead to this full delivery and works it through mid-wicket for three good runs.
Flighted delivery outside off, it's driven towards mid off for one.
Drifting in from around off, defended.
Ravichandran Ashwin walks in next, replacing Rahane!

OUT! RAHANE IS GONE! That's a very soft dismissal really, Rahane should be disappointed with that. Nice amount of flight, tossed up outside off, it's slower through the air as Ajinkya Rahane leans ahead to drive. He's a bit too early into the shot and ends up playing uppishly. It lobs straight towards Nathan Lyon at extra cover who takes a good catch diving forward. India slip further.
Tossed up quite full, outside off, Rahane comes ahead and blocks it out.
From around the wicket, O'Keefe darts it full on middle and gets it to come in, it's worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Sweetly done! Floats it up around off, Rahane sits down on one knee and nails the sweep through square leg. Played it really well!
Goes back to play this one but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Rahane comes down the track to heave it over mid-wicket but gets an inside edge on the pads.
On middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a single.
Comes down the track and blocks it well.
FOUR! Slider around middle and leg, Pujara pulls it through fine leg for another boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Crunched! O'Keefe once again is on the shorter side, Rahane rocks back and punches it through extra cover. Through the gap and away she races for another boundary.
Tossed it up around off, Rahane once again defends it by lunging forward.
Full and around off, Ajinkya defends it down.
FOUR! Edged and over the slip cordon! Short and flat outside off, Rahane camps back to cut but gets a thick outside edge which goes over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Flatter one around off, Pujara gets back and punches it through covers for a single.
Full and loopy around off, defended off the front foot to end the over.
That's hit the batsman on his pads and rolls to square leg. The umpire signals leg bye as the batsmen cross.
Gripping in again, Cheteshwar does well to work it in front of short leg.
Michael Clarke just informs on air that Glenn Maxwell is out on the field for David Warner!

Nathan Lyon is really getting the ball to bounce here, it shoots off the deck as Rahane works it on the leg side for a single. The throw from the deep at the non-striker's end is wayward and they take two overthrows.
Spinning in from around off, Pujara turns it through square leg for a run.

Huge, huge shout for an lbw but to no avail. The umpire doesn't budge. Floated around off, on a length and it's turning in, Pujara stands his ground and looks to play at it but misses to get hit on the back pad. It's too high. Good decision, there.
Nathan Lyon back on to bowl.
The ball hits one of the cracks around off, Rahane comes forward to block but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Loopy ball around off, it bounces away with some turn as Rahane offers no stroke to that one.
Floats it up around off, Pujara looks to drive but gets an inside edge past short leg for a single.
Loopy full around off, defended down into the ground.
Makes a bit of room and punches it towards the off side.
Very full and coming in with the arm, Pujara slices it off the inner half towards the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around the off stump channel, Jinx defends it down safely.
Fuller and down the leg side, Rahane misses his flick as Wade dives full length to stop that one.
Very fuller and on the pads, it's nudged towards long leg for a couple.
Angles it on the pads, tucked towards backward square leg for a single.
Good length ball on off, it's defended with a straight bat.
Full and around off, pushed towards point for a single.
Darted around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting away a touch, Ajinkya pushes it towards covers.
Rahane brings his bat in front of pads and keeps it out.
Ajinkya Rahane is next in to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Right through the gate! Steve O'Keefe has gotten the big fish! He bowls a loopy ball around off, it goes through with the arm, Kohli lunges forward and then for some reason doesn't play at it as he leaves it alone. The ball skids through to rattle the furniture behind. Kohli is stranded as he can't believe, Australia marching along.
Tossed up around off, Kohli comes forward and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Short and outside off, width on offer as well as Pujara places it past gully for a boundary.

Ouch! Slower one around off, it kicks off the turf as Pujara takes his bottom hand off but still gets a beating on the glove. He rings his finger and that should tell you how badly it must have stung him.
A length ball outside off, Cheteshwar stands tall and defends it towards the off side.
Once again in the probing zone outside off, Che has got nothing to do with that one.
Fuller in length and angling in from outside off, Pujara shoulders his arms.
Good length delivery on middle, Pujara defends it off the back foot.
Josh Hazlewood is brought into the attack!
Drinks are on the field!
Loopy delivery around off, Kohli presses forward and defends it down.
Flatter one around off, pushed towards point.
Once again takes a good stride forward to drive but this time he finds the man at short extra cover.
FOUR! Kohli special! Tossed up outside off, Kohli leans into it and drills it through extra cover for a boundary. That should get him going.
Floats it up outside off, Kohli comes forward to drive but the ball goes off the boot towards Smith at first slip.
Quicker through the surface around middle and leg, it's nudged fine down the leg side for one.
Around middle and leg, Kohli gets back and defends it down the wicket.
Nicely tossed up around off, it's dipping in, Pujara comes down the track and drives it down to long on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy ball around off, Pujara advances down the ground and drives it towards covers for a couple of runs.
Floats it up outside off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Drifting in from around off, Che flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Flatter one around middle, flicked off the pads towards fine leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kohli presses forward and buries it into the ground.
Gets behind the line and blocks it out gently.
Comes forward and pushes it towards covers.

A loud shout for LBW! Full and sliding in from around off, Kohli lunges forward to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. A loud shout for LBW has been turned down as there was an inside edge. In fact the replays show it was bat first. So, if the Aussies would have taken the review, the Indian skipper would have been a goner.
Floated ball around off, Cheteshwar covers the line and defends.
Kohli flicks it off the pads towards square leg for a single.
Full on middle and off, Kohli leans across and flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Flattish through the air around middle, Kohli tucks it towards the leg side.
Comes down the track and milks it down to long on for a single.
Full and turning in from around off, Pujara flicks it off the inner half of the bat towards leg slip.
Tossed up from O'Keefe, VK brings his bat ahead of his pad and ensures that the ball dies down on the track ahead.
Loopy and on a fuller length, around off, Virat Kohli plants his front foot forward and defends.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pushed quicker through the air as it's darted on off, a forward block from Virat Kohli.
Drifting in on middle and leg, goes off Virat Kohli's pads as he attempts to glance it away. It runs fine down the leg side as the batsmen take two. Leg byes signalled.
Short and outside off, Kohli stays back to defend.

Four Byes! That spun in a long way and has beaten everyone. On a shorter length, turning in from around off, Pujara hangs his bat out to it and gets beaten. It goes past the inside edge and beats the keeper as well as it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Around off, Che goes back to block it down on the track.
Off spinner around off, Pujara plays with the spin and works it on the on side.
Pujara comes down the track to this fuller ball and works it to mid-wicket.
Floats it on a length, not much turn on this occasion, it's kept out from within the crease.
On a shorter length, turning in from outside off, Pujara walks across a step to play but is hit on the thigh pad.
Some good air and some dip on that occasion, comes into Kohli who manages to get an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They manage to come back for the second.
Drifting in, outside off, driven to covers for nought.
Bowls it slower through the air, around off, Kohli is ahead to block but gets it off the inside edge.
Turning from around off, Kohli looks to play at it but gets an inside edge onto pads.
Looped up on the stumps, worked away on the leg side for a single.

That's in the air but well short. Tossed up nicely by Nathan Lyon, Kohli comes ahead to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. It lobs on the leg side but it falls far from the short leg fielder.
Goes deep inside his crease to this flat ball and defends with a straight blade.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, wristed away past the short leg fielder for one.
Full and coming in on middle and leg, Kohli leans ahead and comfortably works it away on the leg side.
Flatter and shorter in length, outside off, it's kept out off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed it up around off, Pujara pads it away.
Fullish around off, blocked off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
From around the wicket, it's drifting in on middle and off, worked away on the off side for one run.
Floats it up around off, Kohli presses forward to play. It just shoots off the track and it's taken by David Warner at second slip. The umpire remains unmoved.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Some good turn for Nathan Lyon, it's coming back in as Pujara plays at it. Catches him on the thigh pad as the ball falls down on the track after that.
Virat Kohli avoids the pair. He goes back and works it past the diving short leg fielder for a single.
Virat Kohli is the next batsman in. He has a big, big task ahead of him.

OUT! Now both the openers are back in the hut and so are both the reviews. And we're still in the 6th over! Unreal stuff. Lyon floats it outside off, it spins in sharply and keeps very low as well. Rahul moves across to flick it away but is undone by the low bounce and misses. Is caught on the pads and Australia instantly go up in an appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Rahul takes the review. Replays show the impact is the umpire's call and it's going on to hit the stumps. India in some early trouble here.
This time KL Rahul has been caught leg before. The decision from the umpire is that he's out but a review has been taken.

FOUR! Lovely timing on that. As elegant as you'd like. Lyon tosses it up just outside off, it's fractionally overpitched and Rahul is onto it in a flash. He leans ahead and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Rahul leans forward and pushes it through the covers for a couple of runs.
Very full and around off, Pujara defends it down gently.
Cheteshwar Pujara is next in at No.3.

OUT! The decision stays as it is! Steve O'Keefe strikes in his first over! Steve floats it up around middle and off, it skids in a bit, Murali Vijay lunges forward to defend but misses the line and gets rapped on the pads. A loud appeal for an LBW and umpire Kettleborough raises his finger. Vijay walks towards Rahul and then takes the review. Replays show it was in line and would have gone on to clip the leg stump. So, umpire's call! India lose a review as well!
Murali Vijay has been adjudged out leg before wicket. He, after consulting with is partner, has decided to opt for the review.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, Vijay presses forward in defense.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Outside off, turning in with good bounce, Vijay looks to work it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards backward point.
Full and around off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Spin form both ends as Steve O'Keefe comes into the attack!
Flatter through the surface, punched towards covers for a single.

That's nasty! Tossed up around off, it bounces and turns in sharply, takes Rahul by surprise. KL gets back to defend but the extra bounce takes his gloves and lobs towards short leg. Handscomb dives forward but the ball falls just short. Tough chance!
Comes forward to this full ball and defends it down gently.
Outside off, swept through square leg for a single.

Shout for a catch! Loopy delivery around off, turning in, Vijay comes forward to defend but the ball hits his pads and lobs straight into the hands of the fielder at forward short leg. The Aussies appeal but Lyon wasn't interested.
Flatter one around off, Rahul gets back and clips it towards backward square leg for one.
On a length and moving away a bit, Vijay pushes it from the crease towards the point fielder.
Good length delivery on off, Vijay stays back and defends it back to Starc.
A bouncer in the channel outside off, Murali arches back to let it be.
Length delivery on middle and off, Murali shows a straight bat in defense.
Keeps it full and gets it to nip back in a shade, Vijay defends it off the front foot.
Fuller in length and fires it full outside off, Vijay lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, swept through square leg for a single.
Floats it up around off, turning in again, Vijay misses and the ball lobs off the pads towards short leg. They appeal for an lbw but it's missing leg.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Vijay misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Dropped! Tossed up around off, gripping through the surface as Vijay comes forward to flick. The ball goes off the gloves towards short leg and Handscomb stationed there drops the catch.
FOUR BYES! Lyon tosses it up around middle, it turns down sharply, Vijay lunges forward to flick but fails to get any bat on it as the ball races down to the fine leg fence.
Loopy ball around off, turning in, Rahul gets back and works it fine past leg slip for a single. India are away!
Nathan Lyon to share the new cherry with Starc!
Good length ball, angling in, MV works it towards the leg side. A maiden to start the proceedings!
Good cricket all around! Starc hits the deck hard, it shoots off the surface, Vijay arches back and evades it.
Fuller and curling in a bit, Murali drives it straight back to the bowler who brings his left boot out and stops it only to parry it towards mid off.

Very full and outside off, Vijay slices it towards backward point as Mitchell Marsh from gully dives to stop but the ball goes through. Lyon from backward point gets to the ball. Vijay wanted a single but Rahul wasn't interested.
Touch fuller and just around off, Vijay prods forward and pushes it towards covers.
Starts off with a full length delivery, in the channel outside off, Murali Vijay shoulders his arms to that one.
